summary: Sega AM1's 1997 futuristic motorcycle-combat racer for Model 2A arcades, sold as both dedicated cabinets and an update kit for Manx TT Super Bike hardware.

entries.title: Motor Raid

emulation.notes: Use arcade hardware or a legally configured arcade-preservation setup; original sit-down cabinets preserve the physical controls.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Sega Model 2A arcade presentation with linked-cabinet multiplayer on original hardware

primary.why: Motor Raid is a Sega Model 2A arcade racing game with fighting elements, released in single and two-player sit-down motorcycle cabinets and as an update kit for Manx TT Super Bike. It was not ported to Saturn or Windows, so arcade is the only official route.
primary.how_to_play: Play the original arcade version in MAME/original hardware; use linked sit-down cabinets where available for the intended multiplayer setup.

all_releases.fidelity: Original Sega Model 2A arcade release with sit-down motorcycle cabinets and up to four-player linked support.
all_releases.reason: primary: only documented official platform route.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: Only one sourced official platform route; no secondary content route.

entries.remaster_caveats: Not ported to the contemporary Sega Saturn or Windows 95 despite sharing lineage with Manx TT Super Bike hardware.
